message.content: I wake up around nine, usually after a few hours of sleep. I make myself a bowl of porridge for breakfast, then get dressed and brush my teeth. I take the bus to the stationery shop—it's a short ride. When I get there, I start by pricing the notebooks and organizing the pens on display. I check the till to make sure everything is in order. I don't have much interaction with customers in the morning, just a few people passing by. I like the routine, it helps me feel calm. Sometimes, I hear a voice, but it doesn't bother me too much. I just try to focus on my work.
